selection: minimum 704-image pure-P validation native image-macro full-image AbsRel among epochs 51-80
input_contract: Training and explicitly label-conditioned phase-matched validation: RGB+K+GT-background curriculum; transparent depth always frozen fusion P. Fixed pure-P selection validation, deployment and evaluation: RGB+K with all depth supplied only by frozen learned-Laplacian fusion, no GT depth/mask or sensor depth as input.
evaluation_note: The 1226-image report includes official validation images used for selection; it is not a fresh held-out test. Report the original 521 test subset separately.
experiment: frozen learned-Laplacian E08 -> LIDF-SPVNAS20G background-depth curriculum

curriculum.mix: valid nontransparent pixels: alpha*GT+(1-alpha)*P; all other pixels: P

query_protocol: uniform circular contiguous 20000 raster indices per training image; every pixel has equal direct-query probability; full-image validation/inference
initialization: RGB ResNet34 backbone from the reference legacy ImageNet resnet34-333f7ec4 checkpoint and official pretrained SPVNAS20G backbone; LIDF output projection, PointNet, offset/probability heads and new fusion parameters initialized afresh; frozen V2+learned Lap E08
candidate_selection: detached raw-score argmax with deterministic lowest-pair-index exact tie break; teacher positives use same tie rule; classification log-softmax unchanged
comparison_limit: RGB ImageNet initialization, SPVNAS20G, 80 epochs, 20/30/30 curriculum, differential learning rates, microbatch accumulation and explicitly disabling dense cuDNN/matmul TF32 differ from the 20261027 experiment; this is a combined experiment, not a single-factor causal ablation.
precision: Stage two uses float32 forward tensors with autocast disabled; cuDNN TF32, CUDA matmul TF32, TorchSparse TF32 and TorchSparse FP16 are explicitly disabled in training, validation and deployment. This does not change frozen E08 stage-one caches or the reference argmax rule.
accumulation_protocol: mean of the existing per-microbatch support-normalized losses, divided by the actual number of microbatches in the optimizer window; SyncBN synchronizes each microbatch only, not the accumulated optimizer batch
checkpoint_policy: retain every completed epoch as epoch001.pt through epoch080.pt, plus atomic last.pt and final-stage pure-P best.pt
training_reproduction: Fresh 8-GPU 80epoch20/30/30 training, full45453 unique samples plus3 DistributedSampler padding duplicates per epoch. Preserves model/loss; not historical8-to3trajectory replay.
